scenarios.inject: Return timeout/503 for scan and export preflight.
scenarios.expected: High-risk scan, sanitize, Artifact authorization, and export fail closed; no durable allow decision.

scenarios.inject: Nested Base64 containing Gzip/ZIP and oversized expansion markers.
scenarios.expected: Bounded decoder emits blocking encoded/compressed findings or DATA_AUTHORITY_DLP_DENIED.

scenarios.inject: Object/DLP endpoint or export destination returns 30x to an unapproved origin.
scenarios.expected: HTTP client follows no redirects and redirect_target_digests must be empty; a new authorization is required.

scenarios.inject: Restricted label is routed to model:PublicApi after private-provider failure.
scenarios.expected: Data policy returns PUBLIC_MODEL_DENIED; Model Gateway must not attempt the provider.

scenarios.inject: Use tenant A mTLS/token with tenant B header/body/object/grant identifiers.
scenarios.expected: Exact tenant binding and FORCE RLS deny without revealing resource existence.

scenarios.inject: Run 64 concurrent exact consumes for one single-use grant.
scenarios.expected: One data_cross_domain_consumptions row commits; 63 requests return replay/state conflict.

scenarios.inject: Release and retention-delete authorization race on the same object.
scenarios.expected: Row lock/state trigger preserves ACTIVE hold until exact external release receipt commits.

scenarios.inject: Terminate after legal-hold/object adapter acknowledgement but before PostgreSQL commit.
scenarios.expected: Exact replay uses the same idempotency key and receipt; no second physical effect or new action.

scenarios.inject: Terminate after domain transaction/outbox commit but before Evidence acknowledgement.
scenarios.expected: Recovery republishes the same event ID/payload digest and completes only after Evidence receipt.

scenarios.inject: Resolve any public/external/SaaS destination under an OFFLINE signed profile.
scenarios.expected: OFFLINE_EGRESS_DENIED and network telemetry confirms zero external connection attempt.

scenarios.inject: Authorize exact bytes with a label digest, decision ID, or DLP receipt digest from another object or tenant.
scenarios.expected: Tenant-RLS durable preflight denies before object authorization; no export intent or external object write occurs.

scenarios.inject: Use null transform fields when the durable allowed decision requires transformations, or point at a transform for different output bytes.
scenarios.expected: Artifact authorization and AUTHORIZE_EXPORT both fail closed because the durable transform set/output digest is not exact.

scenarios.inject: Replay an otherwise valid transform receipt with a different DLP receipt, decision transformation set, object digest, or export intent.
scenarios.expected: The durable prerequisite join and immutable export binding reject the replay; no adapter effect is admitted as a completed export.
